'''Sector S-29''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] that was home to the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]]' [[Onderon insurgent camp/Legends|secret base]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. It was the site of a [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|small battle]] as well.
